item.tinkers_thinking.paxel.description:
Paxel is a versatile mining tool. It is suitable for almost all kinds of blocks, but excels at breaking rocks and logs.
 The villagers must dislike this.
item.tinkers_thinking.knife.description:
Knife is a cheap, lightweight weapon that is also suitable for cutting ingredients.
 May need to consult a farmer.
item.tinkers_thinking.mace.description:
Mace is a melee weapon that deals more damage the farther a player falls before hitting an entity with it. Successful hits completely negate the user's fall damage.
 Look up!
item.tinkers_thinking.cutlass.descriptio:
The Cutlass is a high-skill melee weapon and defensive tool. It can perform a block with no wind-up and a very short duration. After blocking direct damage, it will automatically counterattack, dealing higher damage and knockback.
 My turn!
item.tinkers_thinking.arrow_thrower.desc: Arrow Thrower is a tool that can throw arrows, allowing ranged damage in melee combat.
item.tinkers_thinking.repeating_crossbow:
The Repeating Crossbow is a long-range tool with high burst damage. It can be loaded with up to 3 arrows at a time and then fire them continuously.
 It cannot be reloaded until all the loaded arrows have been fired.
 Ratatatata~
